strings.Settings.Language.Title: Language
strings.Settings.Language.Description: The app scans JSON files in the Languages folder automatically. Copy an existing file and edit code, displayName, and strings to add a language.
strings.Browser.Title: Browser and platform
strings.Browser.HeadlessDescription: In headless mode, enter a target URL directly. A visible sign-in window opens automatically when login expires.
strings.Browser.UrlWatermark: Enter an author page, short link, or a URL from shared text
strings.Browser.ChromiumPathHint: Chromium is installed in the chromium folder beside the executable.

strings.Capture.Title: Collection strategy
strings.Capture.StopOnDuplicate: Stop after consecutive previously downloaded works
strings.Capture.DuplicateThresholdHint: Default: 20. The counter resets when a new work is found.
strings.Download.Title: Download settings
strings.Download.PageDelay: After every page is processed, wait randomly for 3–10 seconds before loading the next page.
strings.Download.SpeedLimitDescription: Sets the total speed limit for work media downloads; 0 means unlimited. Concurrent videos, images, audio, and HLS segments share this limit. Chromium and FFmpeg component installation is not affected.
strings.Download.ImageCacheDescription: Deletes only avatars and cover images in image-cache. Downloaded works, history, settings, and browser login data are preserved.
strings.Download.CheckAudio: Detect audio and repair silent videos automatically
strings.Download.CheckAudioDescription: Off by default. When enabled, ffprobe checks each downloaded video. If it is silent and background music is available, the app downloads the audio temporarily and merges it with ffmpeg.
strings.Download.CheckAudioImpact: Impact: audio detection waits for each video; silent videos also require audio download and merging, so author downloads take longer.
strings.Download.FfmpegDescription: The app downloads the latest FFmpeg release essentials archive from gyan.dev in the background and extracts ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe to ffmpeg\bin. No browser window is opened.
strings.Download.PersonDetection: Person detection: delete images without people
strings.Download.PersonDetectionConfidenceDescri: Default: 60%. Higher values are stricter and reduce false positives, but distant, small, or blurry people are more likely to be missed.
strings.Download.PersonDetectionDescription: Off by default. Images are saved as .pending and sent to the YoloDotNet background queue. Images containing people are restored; others are deleted. Put person-detection.onnx or yolo11?.onnx in the Models folder.
strings.Download.PersonDetectionImpact: Impact: this uses additional CPU, memory, and disk resources and can delay final statistics and notifications.
strings.PushPlus.Title: WeChat notification
strings.PushPlus.Description: Enter a PushPlus token to send one notification when this author has newly downloaded works. Leave blank to disable.
strings.Remote.Title: Remote control server
strings.Remote.Description: Disabling it stops the listening port immediately. Android, iOS, and web clients will no longer connect.
strings.Remote.SaveToken: Save and activate the new token
strings.Remote.TokenHint: Use 4–64 letters, numbers, or . _ @ -. Web and mobile clients must reconnect with the new token.
